name: Tenkuin Yoichiro
source:
He is the president of Tenkuin Trading and the head of the Tenkuin Group. He is the protagonist's long-lost father. He is quite elderly. Having lost his successors one after another, he is forced to entrust the protagonist with the task of conceiving an heir.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.guilty-soft.com/product/harameido/]official site[/url]]
